tri_state_liveness.ALIVE: original reference valid, no ReferenceError, pointer match, present in live bpy.data.objects.values(), clean enumeration; object_exists is True
tri_state_liveness.ABSENT: proven absent via ReferenceError on original reference and clean bpy.data.objects enumeration confirming absence; object_exists is False
tri_state_liveness.UNKNOWN: missing reference, RNA access exception, pointer mismatch without destruction proof, or collection enumeration exception; object_exists is None (never False)

core_contract_enforcements.failed_isolation_preservation: sweep does not escalate FAILED-B or FAILED-C to TOMBSTONED_FAILED_D when object liveness is UNKNOWN
core_contract_enforcements.tombstone_retirement_gate: tombstone retirement strictly requires status == ABSENT; UNKNOWN returns can_retire=False with reason OBJECT_EXISTENCE_UNVERIFIED
